_doc: src/shared/rng.ts, src/shared/wind.ts and the simulated wind of the browser simulator (tool 4 of Lote 1; the simulator is NOT PX4, and in PX4 SITL the wind is Gazebo's and is not offered). `rng`: with seed 42, `uniform` are the first ten values of mulberry32 (32-bit integer arithmetic: state += 0x6D2B79F5; t = imul(state ^ state>>>15, 1|state); t = (t + imul(t ^ t>>>7, 61|t)) ^ t; (t ^ t>>>14) >>> 0, divided by 2^32; compare exactly, `tolerance.rng` = 0) and `normal` the first ten Box-Muller normals of a fresh generator with the same seed (two uniforms per normal, u1 = 1 - first, u2 = second, sqrt(-2 ln u1) cos(2 pi u2), the sine branch is discarded; `tolerance.normal`). `validate`: validateWind at its borders (`out` is "ok" or the error code). `storage`: parseWind of the text kept under twinsight.sim.wind.v1 (anything invalid gives no wind). `compass`: compassIndex (0 N, 1 NE, 2 E, 3 SE, 4 S, 5 SW, 6 W, 7 NW). `calm`: (b) the mission script of flightsim.json with a configured wind of zero speed and zero gusts gives exactly its rows. `hold`: (c) hover in a 5 m/s wind from the north (a wind from fromDeg blows towards fromDeg + 180; mean wind NED = -speed (cos fromDeg, sin fromDeg); the control compensates most of it, c_w = 0.25 1/s per m/s, and what is left is a steady deviation downwind and a lean into the wind); `targets` are the acceptance values of the spec with their tolerances, `calm` / `north_5` the numbers the model gives. `gusts`: (d) 60 s of hover under gusts (Gauss-Markov per axis, a = exp(-dt/tau), g = g a + sigma sqrt(1 - a^2) xi, once per stepSim call, north then east, always two normals even with sigma 0), one record per second, within `tolerance.gust`. `scenarios` are scripts run on createSim(22, { wind }) in the format of flightsim.json (see its _doc) plus the op `config` (setSimConfig with a partial `cfg.wind`; the reply { reply: "config", ok, detail, event, code } is recorded, `code` only when refused; a new seed restarts the generator and the gusts from calm, any other change keeps them); the rows list the states in `state_columns` then `frame_columns`; `final_gust` and `final_wind_ned` (mean plus gust, m/s) close each one. The wind acts only in flight. The desktop port must reproduce every state number within `tolerance.state`, the frame numbers within `tolerance.frame`, the rpm within `tolerance.rpm` and every string, flag, code and reply text exactly.
